f05.fig_network.callout: The 43,318 accounts that pay other customers fall into 9,263 separate groups, mostly small circles of friends and family, and Louvain finds no finer structure inside any of them, so each group is one community. 12 of the 15 planted rings sit whole inside one community, and the round tripping rule fired on members of 10 of them, every ring with a trip that posted in full. Mule accounts show as stars: many outside senders, one wire out.

f05.fig_network.title: The investigator's view: alerted communities in the transfer network

f05.fig_scorecard.callout: The four rules fired 649 alerts, 7.9 per hundred thousand ledger entries, and found 362 of 422 complete planted episodes. Structuring is where the work is: 41.5% of its alerts are real, because cash intensive businesses deposit just under the threshold for honest reasons. The other three rules fired no false alerts on this generator, which a real program should not expect.

f05.fig_volume.callout: About 18.0 alerts a month, 32 in the busiest, 2024-04. That is the queue an investigator team is staffed for, and the triage order decides which of them is opened first.
